_what: Every substantive claim on this site, and the graph of what it rests on. A claim is only as good as the path from a measurement to it, and that path is usually invisible in prose.

_kinds.held: a dataset on disk, with its faults
_kinds.gap: data that exists but this project cannot reach, or that nobody has measured
_kinds.synthetic: generated to test the method; licenses claims about the instrument, never about the world
_kinds.assumption: stipulated, not measured. The claim is void if it is wrong
_kinds.script: the code that does the work
_kinds.claim: a statement made on a page
_kinds.external: somebody else's published number, used as input

claims.claim: The archive carries a clock time. Startklok is present on 100.0% of 1,805,827 water-chemistry rows.
claims.note: Corrects a claim this project made for weeks, that no row in the archive carried a clock time. That was true of the CTD extract and inferred from the absence of a download.

claims.claim: The 09:00-15:00 sampling window loses about three quarters of a diurnal signal of any amplitude.
claims.note: Nearly assumption-free: the same visits compared with themselves, only the hour redrawn. Does NOT claim the sea has such a cycle.

claims.claim: The surface diurnal oxygen amplitude is below roughly 0.35 to 0.5 mg/l.
claims.note: A bound, not a null. Void if the signal has a shape unlike sun elevation, or if the noise is far from Gaussian.

claims.claim: Nothing in the archive constrains the pre-dawn oxygen minimum, which is the value a threshold is about.
claims.note: Not a finding about the sea. A statement about when people are willing to be on a boat.

claims.claim: Oxygen at depth cannot be placed in the day: 53.7 million CTD measurements carry a date and no hour.
claims.note: Verified against ODA's own output-field list, not inferred from our extract.

claims.claim: 80% of CTD station-days can borrow a clock from a same-day water-chemistry bottle.
claims.note: PROVISIONAL. The borrowing is unchecked, and G-CLOCK is what would check it. If casts systematically precede bottles, any diurnal pattern found at depth is partly an artefact.

claims.claim: 2,662 businesses - 28% of those declaring land - hold animal units above 1.4 DE per declared hectare, and 56% of the national herd.
claims.note: QUALIFIED by C-DE-VOID: the threshold has no legal force. The physical statement, that this manure must leave the holding, stands.

claims.claim: Danish nitrogen rules do not count animals. The animal unit has no legal force; the binding ceiling is 170 kg organic N per hectare of harmoniareal.
claims.note: Read from the regulation itself. Qualifies C-MANURE, which is framed on DE/ha thresholds.

claims.claim: At least 154 animal-keeping holdings are both exposed and thin, with a median 1.9 years of equity at current loss rates.
claims.note: A FLOOR, not a count. 76.3% of the herd is on businesses filing no accounts, and the filers are the large end.

claims.claim: Surface Si:DIN has risen from a median of 1.11 in 1985 to 3.41 in 2025, contradicting the premise of hypothesis K1.
claims.note: The DRIVER only. The assemblage response remains unscoreable - see G-SPECIES.

claims.claim: Whether the diatom share actually fell cannot be scored.
claims.note: A blocker behind a blocker: K1 was listed as waiting on the vandkemi fetch, which has happened.

claims.claim: 5.847 km2 of modelled flooding on land at 0.1 m or deeper.
claims.note: Depends on a sheet placement that does not model the ~2.95 degree meridian convergence, which displaces corners by 94-350 m - four to ten times the stated registration error.

claims.claim: Where a field's nitrogen enters the stream network cannot be established.
claims.note: Approximable from terrain, but the approximation is untested and there is nothing to test it against.

claims.claim: The cloudburst plan holds 209.0 km of alignment that could carry water on the surface — 168.1 km classed as surface conveyance plus 40.9 km of mixed alignment — against 71.0 km of pipe.
claims.note: Three figures for this quantity were published and none was derived: 210 km on the landing page, 169 km in two documents, and a layer measuring 280 km. All three are defensible under different definitions of 'surface' and nothing said which was in use. 210 was surface plus mix (209.0); 169 was surface alone (168.1). The pipe figure, 71, was right to the kilometre.

_figures: A claim may declare where its number came from. claims.py then reads the live value and refuses to write the page if the sentence no longer matches it. Provenance says what a claim rests on; this says whether it still does.
